summary: Broadcast Communication System (Comunicados Masivos) - Backend 22/22 tests PASSED (100%), Frontend all UI elements verified working. Owner can send institutional broadcasts to role groups with recipient count preview.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/broadcast/permission returns can_send_broadcast:true for owner (200)
Backend: GET /api/broadcast/permission requires authentication (401/403)
Backend: GET /api/broadcast/recipients-count returns counts per role (200)
Backend: GET /api/broadcast/recipients-count with roles filter calculates total (200)
Backend: POST /api/broadcast/send requires authentication (401/403)
Backend: POST /api/broadcast/send validates subject required (400)
Backend: POST /api/broadcast/send validates body required (400)
Backend: POST /api/broadcast/send validates target_roles required (400)
Backend: POST /api/broadcast/send creates broadcast successfully (200)
Backend: GET /api/broadcast/sent returns sent broadcasts with stats (200)
Backend: GET /api/broadcast/{id}/stats returns read/pending counts (200)
Backend: GET /api/broadcast/{id}/stats returns 404 for invalid ID
Backend: GET /api/broadcast/unread returns unread broadcasts list (200)
Backend: POST /api/broadcast/{id}/read marks broadcast as read (200)
Backend: GET /api/broadcast/inbox returns received broadcasts (200)
Backend: PUT /api/settings/roles with allow_admin_broadcast updates correctly (200)
Frontend: Messages page shows 'Comunicados' folder in sidebar with data-testid='folder-broadcasts'
Frontend: Compose modal shows 'Comunicado Institucional' toggle for owner (data-testid='broadcast-toggle')
Frontend: Compose modal shows role checkboxes when broadcast toggle is ON (Profesores, Alumnos, Padres, Administradores)
Frontend: Role checkboxes show user counts (e.g., '0 usuarios' for empty school)
Frontend: Comunicados folder shows broadcast messages with COMUNICADO tag and read stats
Frontend: Settings page shows 'Comunicados Institucionales' section (data-testid='broadcast-settings-section')
Frontend: Settings page shows admin broadcast toggle (data-testid='toggle-admin-broadcast')
Frontend: Dashboard integrates BroadcastPopup and BroadcastBanner components
Frontend: NotificationBell integrates broadcast notification count
seed_data_creation: Test broadcasts created during backend pytest with prefix TEST_BROADCAST_. 2 existing broadcast messages visible in Comunicados folder.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Broadcast system fully functional. Routes: /elroble/mensajes for Messages, /elroble/settings for Settings. Owner can send broadcasts to role groups (teacher/student/parent/admin). School has 0 students/teachers/parents so recipient counts show 0, but API structure is correct. BroadcastPopup shows as mandatory overlay for unread broadcasts. BroadcastBanner shows as dismissible banner on dashboard.

backend_endpoints.GET /api/broadcast/permission: Check if user can send broadcasts (owner always true, admin if allowed)
backend_endpoints.GET /api/broadcast/recipients-count: Get count of users per role for broadcast targeting
backend_endpoints.POST /api/broadcast/send: Create and send broadcast to selected roles
backend_endpoints.GET /api/broadcast/sent: List sent broadcasts with read stats (for senders)
backend_endpoints.GET /api/broadcast/{id}/stats: Detailed read/pending statistics for a broadcast
backend_endpoints.GET /api/broadcast/unread: List unread broadcasts for current user (for recipients)
backend_endpoints.GET /api/broadcast/inbox: All received broadcasts with read status

frontend_messages_page.compose_modal: Broadcast toggle and role checkboxes for owner/authorized users
frontend_messages_page.broadcast_list: COMUNICADO tag, sender name, read stats for sent broadcasts
frontend_messages_page.recipient_preview: Shows count per role and total when roles selected

frontend_dashboard.BroadcastBanner: Dismissible banner showing latest unread broadcast

frontend_notification_bell.broadcast_count: Shows unread broadcast count in notification dropdown
